Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class EvaluationCycleDAOimpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<EvaluationCycle,Long>
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.EvaluationCycleDAOimpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<EvaluationCycle,Long>, EvaluationCycleDAO
public class EvaluationCycleDAOimpl extends AbstractDAO<EvaluationCycle,Long> implements EvaluationCycleDAO
Stateless EJB implementation of the EvaluationCycleDAO interface.

This class provides concrete implementation for managing evaluation cycles in the performance evaluation system. It extends AbstractDAO to leverage common CRUD operations and implements specific business logic for evaluation cycle management.

Key implementation features:

  • Uses named queries for optimized database operations
  • Provides optional lazy loading control for evaluation collections
  • Implements efficient status update operations
  • Supports both active and all cycle retrieval with performance optimization

  • Method Details

    • findActive

      public List<EvaluationCycle> findActive(boolean getEvaluations)
      Retrieves all active evaluation cycles from the data store.

      An active evaluation cycle is one that has a status allowing for ongoing evaluation activities. This method provides flexibility to optionally load associated evaluation data for performance optimization.

      Implementation uses the named query "EvaluationCycle.findActive" for optimized performance. When evaluation data is requested, uses Hibernate's lazy loading initialization to fetch the evaluation collections.

      Specified by:
      findActive in interface EvaluationCycleDAO
      Parameters:
      getEvaluations - true to fetch associated evaluation entities, false to exclude them for better performance
      Returns:
      A List of active evaluation cycles, or an empty list if none exist

    • countActiveEvaluationCycles

      public Long countActiveEvaluationCycles()
      Counts the total number of active evaluation cycles.

      This method provides a quick count of evaluation cycles that are currently active in the system. Useful for dashboard displays and system monitoring.

      Implementation uses the named query "EvaluationCycle.countActive" which provides an optimized count operation without loading full entity objects.

      Specified by:
      countActiveEvaluationCycles in interface EvaluationCycleDAO
      Returns:
      The count of active evaluation cycles, or 0 if none exist

    • findAll

      public List<EvaluationCycle> findAll(boolean loadEvaluations)
      Retrieves all evaluation cycles with optional evaluation data loading.

      This method provides flexibility to fetch all evaluation cycles while controlling whether associated evaluation entities should be loaded. Use loadEvaluations = false for better performance when evaluation details are not needed.

      Implementation uses the named query "EvaluationCycle.findAll" with optional evaluation data loading. This provides flexibility for different use cases where evaluation details may or may not be needed.

      Specified by:
      findAll in interface EvaluationCycleDAO
      Parameters:
      loadEvaluations - true to fetch associated evaluation entities, false to exclude them for better performance
      Returns:
      A List of all evaluation cycles, or an empty list if none exist

    • updateStatus

      public void updateStatus(Long cycleId, EvaluationCycleStatus status)
      Updates the status of a specific evaluation cycle.

      This method allows for transitioning evaluation cycles between different states (e.g., from ACTIVE to CLOSED, or from DRAFT to ACTIVE). Status updates may trigger business logic or notifications in the application.

      Implementation uses a direct JPQL UPDATE query for efficient status updates without requiring entity loading. This approach provides better performance for bulk update operations.

      Specified by:
      updateStatus in interface EvaluationCycleDAO
      Parameters:
      cycleId - The unique identifier of the evaluation cycle to update. Must not be null.
      status - The new status to set for the evaluation cycle. Must not be null.
